heuristics: Random-mapping behaviour of the class walk with s = 2^20 adding-walk branches, covered by a 5% step margin

Fruitless cycles of length at most 64 are detected at a fixed period of 64 steps and escaped from the least-key member of the cycle; cycles longer than 64 have probability below 2^-450 per step (structured) and at most 2^-42.6 over the run (random self-collision)
Key and jump-index hashes behave as random functions
limitations: Memory is astronomical (2^53.4 bytes, distinguished-point rate 2^-80) and unscored.
Per-step instruction count is an estimate from blst's 383 instructions per Fp multiplication, charged with a margin.
